title: About Minhaajulhudaa Travels & Tours

content.title: About Us
content.subtitle: Your trusted partner for sacred journeys

content.body: Minhaajulhudaa Travels & Tours was established in 2023 to provide Muslims with seamless, spiritually fulfilling Hajj and Umrah experiences. We are a licensed travel agency specializing in Islamic tourism, with a commitment to making the sacred journeys accessible, affordable, and meaningful.

Our team includes experienced Hajj and Umrah guides who have performed the pilgrimage multiple times. We handle every aspect of your journey - from visa processing and flight bookings to accommodation, transportation, and guided tours of the holy sites.

We also offer local and international Islamic tours to historical sites, Islamic landmarks, and Muslim-friendly destinations. Our pre-travel education program ensures that every pilgrim is spiritually and practically prepared for their sacred journey.

seoDescription: Licensed Hajj and Umrah travel agency.
